qwen_tts_designed.purpose: the roster's speech: every character clones its designed synthetic reference, stored in app data by digest; it refuses a reference that is not there
qwen_tts_designed.training_data_provenance: vendor-documented; not independently verified. Like the 0.6B Base, the licence says nothing about whose voices it was trained on.

Commercial users must register at https://stability.ai/community-license. The bundled T5Gemma text encoder is redistributed under the Gemma Terms of Use (LICENSE_GEMMA.md).
stable_audio_sfx.purpose: context sound and ambience for scene renders; never speech
stable_audio_sfx.training_data_provenance: vendor-documented, not independently verified: Stability's model card states 1,278,902 recordings — 806,284 licensed from AudioSparx and 472,618 from Freesound under CC0, CC-BY or CC-Sampling+, with music screened by a content-detection service and identified copyrighted material removed. That is Stability's claim about their corpus; nothing in this repository checks it.
